title: Bombay
desc: A Hindu man and a Muslim woman fall in love, but their families oppose their union. As a result, they decide to elope and start a new life in Bombay, unaware of the dangers the future holds.

title: Ayya
desc: An upright police officer is up against a conniving group of criminals. To put them behind bars, he devises a series of unconventional methods.

title: Amma Ammaayiyamma
desc: Prabhavathy, one of five children, marries a rich businessman, Shekharankutty, and forgets about her family. Her husband decides to make her understand the importance of her family.

title: Revolver Rita
desc: A woman begins to chase down the culprits after her handbag is stolen. However, things take a turn when the thieves find weapons in their loot, causing them to question the identity of their victim.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Ee Pattanathil Bhootham
desc: An evil magician releases a friendly spirit and orders him to make money through crime. However, the spirit falls into the hands of circus children after the sorcerer loses him in an accident.
